# Deploylight

> Deploylight is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app that shows Vercel deployments, Cloudflare Workers Builds and GitHub Actions runs as they build, succeed or fail.

## Facts

- Price: free. License: MIT. There is no account or subscription.
- Requires macOS 13 or later. Release builds are code-signed and notarized.
- Download: https://github.com/andrewk17/deploylight/releases/latest
- Vercel: shows deployments from personal accounts and teams, using a Vercel access token.
- Cloudflare: shows Workers that build with Workers Builds. Needs a user API token with Workers Builds Configuration: Read and Workers Scripts: Read. Cloudflare Pages projects are not supported.
- GitHub Actions: shows workflow runs, by default from workflows with "deploy" in their name or file path. Needs a fine-grained token with Actions: Read-only. This is how Workers deployed with `wrangler deploy` from a workflow appear.
- Tokens are stored in the macOS Keychain. The app calls each provider's API directly from the Mac. There is no Deploylight server.
- It checks every 15 seconds by default, and every 2 seconds while a build is running.
- Formerly named Vercel Deployment Menu Bar.
- Made by Andrew Kim (https://andrewkim.me).
